use: Post-run adjudication only. Not imported/read by inference runner or sent to either model. Curator selected retrospectively with outcome knowledge.

official_findings.summary: DOJ case record records Sanberg pleading guilty to two wire-fraud counts.
DOJ sentencing release states that sham-customer receipts funded by Sanberg inflated Aspiration revenue between March 2021 and November 2022.
The complaint identifies the exact February 2022 release and $100.6m FY2021 revenue claim; this complaint alone is an allegation, not an adjudication.

eligibility.reason: Bloomberg published an investigation of questionable Aspiration deals on 2024-07-10. Internal 2022 events later described in a 2025 complaint are not automatically public-in-2022 evidence.

scoring_rules.risk_hit: elevated plus valid cited pre-cutoff grounds; otherwise separately report category match and evidence adequacy. No numerical accuracy from one positive event.
scoring_rules.fact_verdict: Audit against actually fetched pre-cutoff text, not against later gold. A press release supports reported attribution, not independent authenticity.
scoring_rules.origin: Identify actual issuer release. Starting at a primary release is not counted as discovering an upstream origin. Native chain quality is separately audited.
scoring_rules.fabrication: Only supplied contemporaneous evidence establishes deliberate fabrication; refusal or elevated risk is not fabrication detection.
